description: Time-series of electricity unit rates for a specific tariff — for Agile this is the half-hourly wholesale-tracked pricing. Returns {count, results:[{value_exc_vat, value_inc_vat, valid_from, valid_to, payment_method}]} in p/kWh, newest first. Set kind="standing_charges" for the p/day standing charge instead. Defaults to the most recent rates; pass period_from/period_to to bound a window.

tariffCode.description: Tariff code from product_details, e.g. "E-1R-AGILE-24-10-01-C" (the trailing letter is the GSP region).

name: tariff_unit_rates
title: Tariff Unit Rates
